title: 10 Common Myths About Organic Food
summary: Myth-busting list: organic labels allow non-organic content, organic farms use pesticides, organic is not more nutritious, and fraud and lower yields are real.

assertions.quote: any organic ingredient can actually be 95 organic and still say organic on the label
organic farms can and do use pesticides
organic pesticides can actually be deadlier than synthetic ones
you're likely to find less pesticide residue on organic crops than non-organic
organic farming does not make food more nutritious
organic farms require up to 35 more labor to maintain thanks to organic practices

verdicts.note: Weeding and pest control without herbicides raise labour per hectare on most organic farms.

assertions.quote: a number of studies have shown that products that hit the market with the organic label are just not organic at all
in 2017 the washington post inspected a massive shipment of 36 million pounds of organic soybeans from ukraine they weren't organic at all
organic farming would require more space
absolutely destroy the argument that organic can feed as many people it just can't
integrated cultures are how organic farming often works this sees a rotation of crops which in turn has a variety of benefits soil fertility
